nodes_add.name: Maheshwarnath Babaji
nodes_add.note: Natha yogi known only from Sri M's autobiography: met him at nine in Thiruvananthapuram and at Vyasa cave near Badrinath when he was 19; trained him for about three and a half years; described as a senior disciple of Sri Guru Babaji. No independent record.

nodes_update.name: Sri M
nodes_update.note: Born Mumtaz Ali Khan, Thiruvananthapuram, 6 November 1948 (1949 in some sources); Natha name Madhukarnath; began teaching 1998; Satsang Foundation, Madanapalle; Walk of Hope 12 Jan 2015 to 29 Apr 2016; Padma Bhushan 2020.

edges_upsert.note: By Sri M's own account in Apprenticed to a Himalayan Master: initiated him into the Natha tradition at about 19 near Badrinath; about three and a half years together. Verified only that he makes this claim.
Sri M describes Maheshwarnath as a senior disciple of Sri Guru Babaji, whom he identifies with Mahavatar Babaji.
By his account he met Sri Guru Babaji in the Himalaya through Maheshwarnath and recognised him as his master in a former life; Kriya is his parampara.
Natha yogi in Sri M's account.
Worked in Krishnamurti institutions and became a confidant (Open, 2014); time with the Krishnamurti Foundation (Wikipedia), where he met his wife.

glossary.def: An order of Shaiva yogis who trace their line to Matsyendranath and Gorakhnath and are closely tied to the origins of hatha yoga; members often take names ending in -nath.
